acceptanceCriteria: The system displays the promo code discount amount for both the outbound and return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation when a return trip order with a promo code is submitted.
The Mozio email confirmation shows the promo code discount amount for the return trip line item equal to the discount applied in the order payload for that line item.

When a return trip order contains multiple line items (e.g., outbound and return senior tickets), the system renders the promo code discount amount for each line item independently based on the discount data in the order payload.
The system does not omit or zero out the promo code discount amount for the return trip line item when the outbound trip line item also has a promo discount applied.

When a promo code is applied to a single-trip (one-way) order, the system continues to display the promo code discount amount correctly in the Mozio email confirmation, ensuring no regression for non-return orders.
When the order payload contains no promo code discount for a return trip line item, the system does not display a promo code discount amount for that line item in the Mozio email confirmation.

The system displays the promo code discount amount for return trip tickets in the Mozio email confirmation in the same format and position as the outbound trip discount amount, ensuring visual and structural consistency between the two trip directions.
